title: Grilled Pescador Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Brazilian-inspired dish featuring grilled fish and seafood skewers.

ingredients.name: 1/2 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/4 cup oceanic sauce (such as malagueta sauce)

instructions: Thread fish, shrimp, and squid onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together oceanic sauce, lime juice, garlic, and cilantro.
Brush the skewers with the marinade, making sure to coat all surfaces.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the shrimp and squid are opaque and slightly charred.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
